label: MARKETING TERM
headline: Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)
body: This is the total cost spent on marketing and sales efforts to gain one new customer.
caption:
Understanding your Customer Acquisition Cost helps you see how much you're investing to bring new people onboard. For a freelancer, this might include the time spent on networking, the cost of an online ad, or your subscription to a design tool you use to create promotional materials.
